title: 전략사령부령 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Duties of Commander and Other Officers)
(1) The Commander shall, under the direction of the Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, exercise overall control over the affairs of the Command and exercise operational control over the operational units of each armed service and joint units designated by the Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff.
(2) The Chief of Staff shall assist the Commander and, under the Commander's direction, coordinate, control, and supervise staff duties, and shall perform the Commander's duties on an acting basis if the Commander is unable to perform them due to unavoidable circumstances.
